{{Top|leg}}
'''Zero Squadron''' comprised two dozen [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] under the command of [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Klyn Shanga]] on behalf of the [[Renatasian Confederation]]. The [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] hunted the so-called ''[[Butcher of Renatasia]]'' and attached their fighters with long cables to the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] of a large [[dreadnought]] to enable the starfighters to travel through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and later to a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[pinnace]]&mdash;acquired by pilot [[Bern Nuladeg]]&mdash;for the purpose of providing enhanced [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] to the fighters.
